steps.say: An agent read this office's point cloud, wall by wall.

steps.caption: the entrance, with no points
steps.say: It noticed the entrance had never been scanned, and asked for it.

scenes.headline: Eight capture posts, sorted by what they hand you
scenes.sub: A drawing, a report, a splat, a pose or a massing model
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cornice. Eight reality capture posts this week. For each one, what actually comes out?

scenes.title: What a slice says about a wall

params.face: the inside face: hundreds of points, one line
params.thick: the outside face: no points, so no thickness
params.beam: a face 400 mm proud: beam or wall?

steps.term: Plan slice: a cut through the cloud
steps.say: Cut the cloud a metre up and you get a plan. The wall's inside face is hundreds of points on one line.
Scanned from inside, the outside face has no points. Thickness is a guess.
Glass returns nothing, so a window reads as the glass between the frames, narrower than the opening.
Higher up, the cut meets a beam. A beam and a short wall look the same here.

steps.caption: Jw_cad, driven by the agent
steps.say: Then it drove a Japanese CAD package to draw a real plan, and left what it could not read marked for a site check.
The cloud was synthetic, though. Real ones fail in ways this one cannot.

states.say: Sort the eight by what they hand you.
One drawing. One appraisal report. Two pictures to look at. Three poses or maps. One massing model. No BIM elements yet.

steps.caption: no initial pose
steps.say: This open source localizer starts with no idea where the robot is.
It searches the whole map, and two searches have to agree.

scenes.title: Branch and bound over the whole floor

params.scan: a scan from the east room, and no pose
params.bound: each block's score can only fall as it splits
params.best: best first, down to single cells
params.tie: two identical rooms tie; the tie-break picks west
params.again: query two, after moving into the corridor
params.reject: the first answer, moved, misses: reject

steps.say: Take two identical rooms. The robot stands in the east one.

steps.term: Upper bound: no pose inside can score more
steps.say: Pool the map into coarse blocks. A block's hit count bounds every pose inside it.
Open the best block first, down to single cells. Both rooms score exactly the same, and the tie goes west. Wrong.
Move into the corridor and ask again. The pillar breaks the tie, so the pair is rejected.

steps.caption: map and scans from different runs
steps.say: The post's map came from the same recording. The same day, the README showed a run across two sessions instead.

scenes.label: cross-session starts more than 1 m off
scenes.say: Its own benchmark prints the failures. Five of twenty-four cross-session starts were wrong. Four of them had passed the two-query check.

steps.caption: one fix every 5 s, played at 5x
steps.say: And this 360 camera is located from its frames alone, one fix every five seconds. Positioning, not tracking.

scenes.text: Leave what the scan cannot see on the drawing as a site check.
scenes.say: The habit worth copying: leave what the scan cannot see on the drawing, as a site check.

recap: A slice gives faces, not thickness
Two queries agreeing is not proof
Sort tools by what they hand you
scenes.say: Faces, not thickness. Agreement, not proof. And ask what comes out.
